selection_scope: Known309 plus declared systematic TRAIN/development component domains. Prior fresh84/fresh100 are now known; their failed gates remain archived. Reserved new40 outcomes unopened and excluded from UC2-4/tutorial training.
selector_input: Immutable native fixture identity only; no case ID, timetable lookup, future fault or outcome selection during inference.

uc2-1.selection_basis: Native complete per-case PP non-regression on the declared known component domain, with unchanged model architecture

tutorial.selection_basis: Native complete per-case PP non-regression on the declared known component domain, with unchanged model architecture

evidence_boundary: The known309 gate is inferred from independently executed selected component domains; an actual exported registry-known309 run is required before candidate freeze. This is selection evidence, not a new40 result.
projected_uc23_labels: Explicit native-validated safe STOP corrections under ROAM, plus neural-prior KL and genuine PP7 CE. These projected/prior labels are not misattributed to raw PP/DLA.
